description: Short real-run smoke for var (VAR next-scale autoregressive generative pretraining): pretrain -> encoder.pt and an independent linear_eval, one epoch each on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. This is the EVAL_DOWNLOAD generative shape (docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md): the probe reads the VQVAE tokeniser's features, NOT the VAR transformer that pretrain trains, so linear_eval consumes no encoder.pt and the two stages are independent. The full VAR-d16 recipe (depth 16, ch 160, vocab_size 4096, patch_nums up to 16) is shrunk to the tiny architecture the method's own test exercises on CPU: patch_nums [1,2,3], vocab_size 16, ch 32, num_classes 4, depth 2 -- the real architecture, just small. The pretrained VQVAE tokeniser is a download (bin/fetch-weights.py); the hermetic smoke leaves VQVAE_CKPT empty so a random VQVAE is built instead, exercising the pipeline (its accuracy is meaningless by design). linear_eval runs at img_size 32 (a 2x2 map over the VQVAE's 16x downsample). The same model keys are set in both stages so the tokeniser is rebuilt identically; only the run-length knobs and the tiny-arch dims are overridden.
